name: Maximum-Generated Classes Are Closed under Cartesian Products
statement: The Cartesian product of two nonempty maximum-generated classes on disjoint visible coordinate sets is maximum-generated.
proof: Extend maximum parents of ranks $r,s$ to maximum sequences. Delay the first sequence $s$ levels above its parent and the second $r$ levels above its parent, then take the level sum at $r+s$. On the marked delay face a pair has total entry level at most $r+s$ exactly when both entries lie in their supplied parents. Fixing the original marks therefore yields the product section.
